data.title: Evacuations in Malibu after waves open sinkhole at Nicolas Cage's house
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - People living in an upmarket coastal stretch of Malibu were under an evacuation order Wednesday after a giant sinkhole opened up on the driveway of a beachfront home belonging to Oscar-winning US actor Nicolas Cage.

data.title: 'Alarm bells ringing': US summer heat shatters record
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The contiguous United States has endured its hottest summer on record, a new peak that scientists said should send alarm bells ringing over the increasingly dire impacts of climate change.

data.title: Apple unveils its first foldable smartphone iPhone Duo
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - Apple unveiled its long-awaited first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, on Wednesday, at the company's first launch event since CEO John Ternus took the reins on September 1.

data.title: Heat forces French champagne makers to stiffen their drink
data.description: LILLE, France - Drinking this year’s champagne might give you a heftier headache as France’s record heatwaves are forcing some producers to up the alcohol levels, industry officials said on Wednesday.

data.title: French far-right party expels policeman over racist remarks
data.description: CARCASSONNE, France - France's main far-right party has expelled a member who is a policeman after body cam footage of him making racist comments sparked outrage ahead of presidential elections it hopes to win next year.

data.title: ‘Nothing left’: Thousands in Yemen flee deadly clashes
data.description: KHOKHA, Yemen - Salama Saeed and her son fled for their lives when shelling and gunfire from Yemen’s Houthi rebels engulfed their village, forcing her to leave other children behind.

data.title: Spain endured ‘hottest summer on record’
data.description: MADRID - Mainland Spain endured its hottest summer since records began in 1961, with an unprecedented 61 heatwave days across June, July and August, the national weather agency AEMET said on Wednesday.

data.title: US Republicans start to look beyond Trump
data.description: DALLAS - Republicans gathering in Dallas this week will celebrate President Donald Trump and rally support ​ahead of US midterm elections, but a disappointing showing in the November 3 vote could sharpen ‌an already simmering debate over who comes next and what will become of the party he transformed.

data.title: EU to help cities rein in Airbnb, holiday rentals
data.description: BRUSSELS - European cities will gain more leeway to curb short-term rentals such as Airbnb under plans aimed at bringing down housing costs in tourism hotspots put forward by the European Union on Wednesday.

data.title: ‘Long live Chairman Mao’: Supporters mark 50th anniversary of death
data.description: SHAOSHAN, China - Fifty years after his death, diehard fans of the Chinese Communist leader Mao Zedong lined up on Wednesday in his hometown to pay homage, holding portraits, flags and huge floral tributes.

data.title: No breaks for graft convicts, says Malaysian coalition
data.description: KUALA ‌LUMPUR - Malaysia’s governing coalition said on Wednesday that people convicted in high-profile graft cases should serve their sentences in full, amid reports that jailed former premier Najib Razak has made another bid for a royal pardon.

data.title: German leader accuses AfD of promoting ‘ethnic cleansing’
data.description: BERLIN - German Chancellor Friedrich Merz labelled the demands of the Alternative for Germany (AfD) for mass “remigration” a form of “ethnic cleansing by skin colour and origin” in a heated parliamentary exchange Wednesday.

data.title: Saudis step up strikes against Yemen rebels
data.description: SANAA - Yemen’s Houthi rebels reported dozens of Saudi airstrikes on Wednesday as daily attacks continued in a conflict that has reignited during the Middle East war, with hundreds of people killed in fighting near the Red Sea.

data.title: Indonesian wildfire emissions surge to world's highest
data.description: Fires are burning through forests and peatland in Borneo and Sumatra, Indonesia

data.title: South Korea video game tycoon to pay record $1.5 billion in divorce
data.description: SEOUL — A Seoul court on Wednesday ordered South Korean video game tycoon Kwon Hyuk-bin to pay more than 2 trillion won (US$1.5 billion) in a divorce settlement, the largest asset division ever awarded in the country.

data.title: 'Long live Chairman Mao': Supporters pay respects to founder of Communist China
data.description: SHAOSHAN (CHINA) - Fifty years after his death, diehard fans of the Chinese Communist leader Mao Zedong lined up on Wednesday in his hometown to pay homage, holding portraits, flags and huge floral tributes.

data.title: China needs monkeys: lab animal shortage could hinder biotech growth
data.description: HONG KONG — China’s biotechnology market has “significantly” driven up the demand for primate experimental models as the market recovers, tightening the supply of laboratory monkeys, according to a leading biotech firm.

data.title: Protesters urge South Korea to stay out of Iran war
data.description: SEOUL - Dozens of South Koreans urged their government on Wednesday not to deploy troops to the strategic Strait of Hormuz, slamming what they called Washington's "illegal war".

data.title: Africa's informal economy: a burden and lifeline
data.description: ABIDJAN - Across the pavements, residential areas and public spaces of African cities, the informal economy is booming under the noses of authorities, who are often powerless to stop it.

data.title: EU to help cities tighten screws on Airbnb, holiday rentals
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - European cities will gain more leeway to curb short-term rentals such as Airbnb under plans to bring down housing costs in tourism hotspots that the European Union is to unveil on Wednesday.
